svg.aria-label: Finder — Projects: CleanBRUH (Swift · macOS): Locks keyboard, mouse and trackpad so you can clean your Mac [Available]; Cafelero (Swift · macOS): Keeps your Mac's screen on for as long as you choose [Available]; ConvertBRUH (Swift · macOS): Converts files right from the Finder [Available]; UnRecent (Swift · macOS): Removes files from macOS “Recents” without deleting them [Coming soon]; Djoko_vox (C++): Audio plugin: a recording channel strip, in testing with users [Coming soon]; Online store (Next.js · Stripe · R2): E-commerce: Stripe payments, R2 and signed download links [Private]
svg.text: so you can clean your Mac
for as long as you choose
